name: Schwartz Farms Mt. Vernon
description: In Dix, IL, Schwartz Farms Mt. Vernon grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Pears, and Peaches on a family-run pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
